other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Arunachal Pradesh.
Applicant must be a family member of a deceased worker employed in building and other construction works.
The deceased worker must be registered with the Labour Welfare Board (APB&OCWWB) and have an active membership at the time of death.
The nominee/dependent’s name must be recorded on the worker’s registration card before death.
benefits_summary: Cash assistance of ₹1000 is provided to the nominee of the deceased worker.
